reviews.review: This is really fun especially with 4 players. Has the feel of ridiculous arcade shooters and the weapon variety makes each run feel different. Also really funny to have all 4 players spamming the dialogue choices at each other mid game.
Won't force you to create a PSN account

Just got all the main missions done singleplayer on hard for my ranger so I think I'm somewhat qualified to talk about this. Got into this game after seeing a youtuber shill it. Everything you see in the previews is what is GOOD about the game. Let me tell you everything BAD and you can make your judgement from there.
GENERAL:
1. $60.00 up front. AAA game price not including the dlc.
2. Dialogue and voices for this game is extremely cheesy and dumb, like a six year old wrote it. Even if you don't care about that sort of thing, what intelligence barren drivel that comes out of their mouths will make you care. Even as satire it's bad.  
3. Game will actively give you bad advice on how to play.
4. Steals your camera control from you to look at things during combat. Does not pause the game while doing this. 

AI:
3. AI cannot pilot vehicle turrets so in singleplayer you're going to have to get in and out of different weapons if you want to use it to the fullest advantage.
4. AI spouts terrible dialogue over and over
5. AI follows you around, sometimes getting in the way of your shot.
6. AI is immortal, but only to friendly fire. When you inevitably snap and shoot your teammates they will get up. They only die when you need them to live.

WEAPONS/CLASSES
7.  All classes have at least a handful of dumb weapons. While most weapons have infinite ammo for obvious reasons, when I say "dumb" I mean weapons so bad that you wonder what drugs the developers were on when they made them. To give a few examples: 
    Fencer has around 2-3 weapons that CANNOT BE USED IN SINGLEPLAYER. You need to play multiplayer, find someone to play air raider and then maybe MAYBE you can use these weapons. On it's own it just's a paperweight. Oh and he's also got a gun that has 10 regular shots total. In a game where you're going to fight enemies in droves. 
    Air raider may seem overpowered, but you sing a different tune when you realize a good portion of these missions take place underground or with indestructible ships above you. If there is something above you, obviously your artillery will not work. Making close to half of your weapons useless. Come to think of it only a select few vehicles can be called underground. 
   Wing diver is incredibly fragile and can get one-shot even if you're well into the game. Most of her stuff is highly inaccurate explosive weapons so you will kill yourself on the regular. One weapon in particular actually requires you to fly ABOVE the target for a successful shot. I'm not talking about a grenade, I'm talking about a physical gun that shoots a explosive plasmashot at a 90 degree angle DIRECTLY BELOW you. If you fire this weapon while on the ground you will die. Also all of her weapons use power in her battery. If you use a late game weapon without getting a late game battery, you will completely deplete your battery by just reloading your gun.
   Lastly Ranger has a plethora of miscellaneous weapons like "acid spray that only has a 1m of range" "shotgun-sniper-rifle", "Missile launcher that takes 20 seconds to lock on" "Grenade that makes you do a little 5-10s animation everytime it's used", "healing gun with fixed ammo", "Helicopter that can only fly around because you need to play multiplayer to get people to man your guns" the list goes on.

And yes you CAN upgrade these weapons, but not all of these problems can be fixed via upgrades, only certain ones, and that's after all the grind you do to make a weapon good. Sometimes this game gives you a power fantasy, but other times it's a joke.



MULTIPLAYER:
8. Not really a problem with the game, but people in multiplayer tend to be asshats who call artillery strikes on you. Rarely will they get in your vehicles. Most of the time they will play wingdiver and float away to the other side of the map.
9. Singleplayer and multiplayer medals are separate. If you beat a mission on x difficulty for singleplayer, you will still need to do the same in multiplayer and vice versa.

All and all I think this game is poorly thought out. It needs a patch and is NOT worth $60. Get it on sale and don't waste your cash on non-mission type dlc.
